textTemplates.description: Email body to be sent in the mail for 24 Hours Notification
textTemplates.name: EmailBody_24_Hours
textTemplates.text:
Hello {!$Record.Parent.Contact.FirstName}

I wanted to follow up with you regarding our previous correspondence. Have you had the opportunity to review my previous email?

A copy of my previous email is below for your reference.

I look forward to hearing from you.

{!OriginalMessage}

Kind Regards,
Iron Mountain Customer Care Team

textTemplates.description: Email body to be sent in the mail for 48 Hours Notification
textTemplates.name: EmailBody_48_Hours
textTemplates.text:
Hello {!$Record.Parent.Contact.FirstName}

I am reaching out to you regarding my previous two emails, as we do not seem to have received a response.

Please can you advise accordingly or alternatively confirm that no further assistance is now required with this matter?

A copy of my previous email is below for your reference.

I look forward to hearing from you.

{!OriginalMessage}

Kind Regards,
Iron Mountain Customer Care Team

textTemplates.description: Email body to be sent in the mail for 72 Hours Notification
textTemplates.name: EmailBody_72_Hours
textTemplates.text:
Hello {!$Record.Parent.Contact.FirstName}

I wanted to reach out to you one last time. Please can you respond to my previous emails to allow me to assist in resolving your query. If we do not receive this information within 24 hours your case may be closed.

A copy of my previous email is below for your reference.

I look forward to hearing from you.

{!OriginalMessage}

Kind Regards,
Iron Mountain Customer Care Team

textTemplates.description: Global Service Case Email Template Body
textTemplates.name: GSC_EmailBody
textTemplates.text:
{!Salutation} {!$Record.Parent.Contact.FirstName}

{!Body}

{!OriginalMessage}

{!Signature}
{!$User.Signature}
